subject: Civil Engineering
title: Ready-Mix and Quality Control
description: A micro-lesson that makes Ready-Mix and Quality Control usable.

hook.text: A spinning drum on a truck keeps concrete mixed during the drive to the job site.

buildup.text: Ready-mix plants batch ingredients by computer — accuracy to the pound.

discovery.text: Concrete must be placed within 90 minutes of mixing — the clock starts at the plant.

twist.text: Cylinder tests at 7 and 28 days verify that delivered concrete meets the specified strength.

climax.text: If cylinders fail, the structure may need coring — drilling samples from the actual concrete.

punchline.text: You can't inspect concrete after it's placed. Test it before it hardens.

quiz.question: Why must ready-mix concrete be placed within 90 minutes?
options: The truck's fuel runs out after 90 minutes of driving
The hydration reaction progresses and the concrete begins to set, losing workability
Safety regulations limit the driver's time on the road
